No masterclass

Downloads don’t turn into decisions

Your workbooks capture emails, but nobody gets to spend an hour with you before deciding. The step that turns “I like her posts” into “I want her as my coach” is missing.

Nothing in the middle

Readers can’t say a small yes

Someone who just finished The Ambition Trap has nowhere to go between a free workbook and private coaching. Your course exists, but only your 1:1 clients ever see it.

No filter

Every consult costs you 30 minutes

All three offers point to the same open booking page. You can’t tell a ready buyer from someone curious until you’re already on the call.

Anyone who loves your work but isn’t ready for private coaching today has nothing to buy, and no reason to raise their hand.

You’ve hit the milestones. So why does the next one feel the same?

Here’s what you’ll learn

Where your ambition really comes from

The difference between ambition driven by pressure and ambition driven by purpose, and how to tell which one is running your week.

How to find your core gifts

Spot your natural strengths and the work that gives you energy, so your next move is built on them.

Working in cycles, not on a treadmill

How to plan around seasons of work and rest so your output doesn’t depend on pushing harder.

Leading like yourself

The Aligned Leadership approach: how to lead and be visible in a way that reflects who you actually are.

Your next 90 days

A simple plan to test your next idea, whether that’s a new role, a new business or a new way of working.

Meet Amina

Hi, I’m Amina AlTai

I’m an executive coach and the author of The Ambition Trap. I coach people who’ve done it all and want to do it differently.

I spent most of my career moving between corporate roles and entrepreneurship, including seven years running a business I built myself.
